comments.content: Potential uninitialized variable 'd' usage in the conditional statement may cause nil pointer dereference. Suggest reviewing the logic to ensure valid checks on 'd' prior to using it.

summary.walkthrough: This pull request introduces a new feature for handling code relocation in the z-code-reviewer tool. It adds functionality to generate relocation prompts for comments when existing code fails to be deterministically positioned, enhancing the tool's ability to manage code reviews effectively.

change_groups.title: Add relocation functionality
change_groups.summary: This group of changes implements the relocation feature by adding a new function to build relocation prompts and integrating it into the review command. It also includes the logic for handling LLM calls to regenerate existing code snippets when deterministic positioning fails. Tests have been added to ensure the functionality works as expected.

change_groups.title: Directory summarization feature
change_groups.summary: This group introduces a directory summarization feature that groups indexed paths by their parent directories and summarizes them using LLM calls. It includes the implementation of the indexing logic and tests to verify that the summarization works correctly.

summary.testing_notes: To test the changes, run the code review process on a sample repository and verify that comments with existing code that cannot be deterministically positioned trigger the new relocation logic. Additionally, check that directory summarization works by indexing a repository with multiple directories and ensuring summaries are generated correctly.
summary.risk: medium: The introduction of LLM calls and new logic for handling code relocation may introduce unexpected behavior if not thoroughly tested.
